title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate an access control policy and procedures; review and update periodically and following defined events.

title: Account Management
text: Define, document, and manage system account types, creation, enabling, modification, disabling, and removal; monitor account use.

title: Access Enforcement
text: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

title: Least Privilege
text: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate an awareness and training policy and procedures.

title: Literacy Training and Awareness
text: Provide security and privacy literacy training to system users as part of initial training and periodically thereafter.

title: Role-Based Training
text: Provide role-based security and privacy training to personnel with assigned security/privacy roles before authorizing access.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate an audit and accountability policy and procedures.

title: Event Logging
text: Identify the types of events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function.

title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
text: Review and analyze system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate an assessment, authorization, and monitoring policy and procedures.

title: Control Assessments
text: Select and develop a control assessment plan; assess controls to determine effectiveness.

title: Continuous Monitoring
text: Develop a continuous monitoring strategy and implement a program including ongoing control assessments.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a configuration management policy and procedures.

title: Baseline Configuration
text: Develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the system.

title: Configuration Settings
text: Establish and document configuration settings using security configuration checklists; implement and monitor for deviations.

title: System Component Inventory
text: Develop and document an inventory of system components that accurately reflects the current system.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a contingency planning policy and procedures.

title: System Backup
text: Conduct backups of user-level and system-level information and system documentation, protecting confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

title: System Recovery and Reconstitution
text: Provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state after a disruption, compromise, or failure.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate an identification and authentication policy and procedures.

title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
text: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that identity with processes acting on behalf of users.

title: Authenticator Management
text: Manage system authenticators by verifying identity, establishing initial content, changing default authenticators, and refreshing authenticators.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate an incident response policy and procedures.

title: Incident Handling
text: Implement an incident handling capability for security incidents that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.

title: Incident Reporting
text: Require personnel to report suspected incidents to the organizational incident response capability within a defined time period.

title: Incident Response Plan
text: Develop an incident response plan that provides the organization with a roadmap for implementing its incident response capability.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a system maintenance policy and procedures.

title: Controlled Maintenance
text: Schedule, document, and review records of maintenance and repairs on system components in accordance with manufacturer specifications.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a media protection policy and procedures.

title: Media Sanitization
text: Sanitize system media prior to disposal, release out of organizational control, or release for reuse.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a physical and environmental protection policy and procedures.

title: Physical Access Control
text: Enforce physical access authorizations at defined entry/exit points; maintain physical access audit logs.

title: Monitoring Physical Access
text: Monitor physical access to the facility and system to detect and respond to physical security incidents.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a security and privacy planning policy and procedures.

title: System Security and Privacy Plans
text: Develop security and privacy plans for the system that are consistent with the organization's enterprise architecture.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a personnel security policy and procedures.

title: Personnel Screening
text: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to the system; rescreen individuals per defined conditions.

title: Personnel Termination
text: Upon termination of individual employment, disable system access, terminate credentials, and conduct exit interviews.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a risk assessment policy and procedures.

title: Risk Assessment
text: Conduct a risk assessment, including the likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access or use.

title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
text: Monitor and scan for vulnerabilities in the system and hosted applications; remediate legitimate vulnerabilities.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a system and services acquisition policy and procedures.

title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles
text: Apply security and privacy engineering principles in the specification, design, development, implementation, and modification of the system.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a system and communications protection policy and procedures.

title: Boundary Protection
text: Monitor and control communications at external and key internal managed interfaces of the system.

title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
text: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
text: Establish and manage cryptographic keys when cryptography is employed within the system.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a system and information integrity policy and procedures.

title: Flaw Remediation
text: Identify, report, and correct system flaws; test software and firmware updates before installation.

title: System Monitoring
text: Monitor the system to detect attacks, indicators of potential attacks, and unauthorized connections.

title: Policy and Procedures
text: Develop, document, and disseminate a supply chain risk management policy and procedures.

title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes
text: Establish a process to identify and address weaknesses or deficiencies in the supply chain elements and processes.

title: Supplier Assessments and Reviews
text: Assess and review the supply chain-related risks associated with suppliers or contractors.
